This brings the same planning capabilities to individual developers and open source maintainers to standardize… The post Issue types and fields are available for personal accounts appeared first on The GitHub Blog .
summary: Issue types and issue fields are now generally available on repositories owned by personal accounts. This brings the same planning capabilities to individual developers and open source maintainers to standardize your workflows and organize issues across repositories.
takeaways: This brings the same planning capabilities to individual developers and open source maintainers to standardize your workflows and organize issues across repositories.
Get started with issue types and issue fields Customize issue types: You can customize issue types from your personal account settings on the Issue types page under “Planning”.
Customize issue fields: You can customize issue fields from your personal account settings on the Issue fields page under “Planning”.
